citations.review_text:
6/10

Well it's a funny walking simulator game where you take different routes and get different results and gags. There isn't really much of it, just pure gags and meta comedy. It's not bad but it's a particular type of humor that I personally didn't find too fun? I mean it's not unbearable and it can be funny sometimes, but it's not something I would find particularly too funny (maybe my mind is rotten from memes idk), other times I just find it boring and wish the narrator could just stop talking instead of trying to extend a joke longer than it needs.

And I may be kinda nitpicky with this one but I feel you kinda get the same experience no matter if you play it yourself or watch a playthrough since there isn't really much gameplay here. I actually think the price of over 20 bucks may be kinda overpriced for what it offers.
Great game, really like how the narrator keeps talking and there is no skip button.
